descripcion: Línea de tiempo de tres etapas (Día 1 / Día 7 / Día 30) dibujada como tres fotos circulares que CRECEN de izquierda a derecha sobre una misma línea horizontal: pequeña, mediana y grande. El mismo sujeto mejora de forma visible y creíble en cada círculo; el último lleva un aro del color de acento. Titular arriba, una etiqueta de tiempo sobre cada círculo, un pie corto debajo y el producto anclado al centro de la franja inferior. El crecimiento de los círculos hace que el progreso se entienda en un segundo.
reference_style: Clean, modern Day 1 / Day 7 / Day 30 progress ad: three circular photo frames of increasing size threaded on one horizontal timeline, showing the same subject improving, with the product anchoring the bottom

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Bold headline at the top. 2) The three circular photos read left to right as growth: small, medium, large, with the largest (final result) circle ringed in the brand accent. 3) The user's product centered in the bottom band. 4) The small time-label pills on top of each circle and the short caption under each one.
art_direction.composition_style: Horizontal left-to-right progression with deliberate size growth. Headline centered in the top band. Three circular photo frames sit side by side with their centers on the same horizontal line at about 46% of the canvas height: circle 1 is about 20% of the canvas width in diameter (centered at about 17% of the canvas width), circle 2 about 25% (centered at about 43%), circle 3 about 32% (centered at about 75%). Equal gaps of about 3.5% of the canvas width separate the circles. A thin timeline track runs behind the circles through their centers, with a small chevron arrow pointing right in each gap. A rounded time-label pill straddles the top edge of each circle, centered on it. A one-line caption sits centered under each circle on a shared baseline. The product stands centered in the bottom band, about 20-22% of the canvas height.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Vertical bands: headline from about 6% to 19% of the canvas height; breathing space down to the top of circle 3 at about 30%; circles between about 30% and 62% (circle 1 spans about 36-56%, circle 2 about 33.5-58.5%, circle 3 about 30-62%); captions on one shared baseline from about 65% to 71%; product band from about 74% to 95%. Horizontally, circle 1 spans about 7-27% of the canvas width, circle 2 about 30.5-55.5% and circle 3 about 59-91%. Safe margins of about 6-7% on every side. Nothing touches the canvas edges and nothing overlaps the photos except the label pills on their top edge.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Inside the circles: identical camera angle, crop and lighting setup across all three stages so only the progression changes; stage 1 slightly cooler and more muted, stage 2 neutral, stage 3 warmest and most vibrant. Each circle has a thin light outline and a soft drop shadow so it floats slightly above the background; circle 3 adds a brand-accent ring (about 1% of the canvas width thick) and a faint accent glow. The product in the bottom band gets a soft studio key light from the upper left, a subtle rim light and a soft contact shadow on an implied surface.

layout_summary: Square canvas with a brand-colored background. Headline centered at the top. Across the middle, three circular photos of the same subject at three stages of visible, believable improvement grow in size from left to right (small, medium, large) along a thin horizontal timeline track that runs through their centers, with a small chevron arrow in each gap. A small rounded time-label pill (e.g. Day 1, Day 7, Day 30) sits on the top edge of each circle, and the largest circle is ringed in the brand accent. A short caption sits under each circle on a shared baseline. The user's product stands centered in the bottom band with a soft shadow.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Calm brand-colored backdrop that keeps the progression clean and readable
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Use the approved palette as a flat color or a very subtle gradient (lighter toward the top). Keep it low-detail so the circles, labels and product read clearly.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top center, from about 6% to 19% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Frames the image as a progress story and stops the scroll
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Write the time-based promise of this variation's angle. Keep it short so it fits in max 2 lines.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Thin horizontal line at about 46% of the canvas height, running behind the three circles through their centers from about 6% to 94% of the canvas width; one small chevron arrow in each of the two gaps
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Threads the three photos into one readable sequence and signals forward progress
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Thin line (about 0.5% of the canvas height) that shifts from a muted palette tone on the left to the brand accent on the right. Two small chevron arrows pointing right, one centered in each gap between circles, in the same color as the line at that point. The line is hidden behind the circles and visible only in the gaps and at both ends.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Left, circular photo about 20% of the canvas width in diameter, spanning about 7-27% of the canvas width and 36-56% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the starting problem state the audience recognizes
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Tight, realistic close-up of the subject the product acts on, cropped to read clearly inside a circle (e.g. a skin or hair area for cosmetics, a face showing energy or tiredness for supplements, a surface or corner of a room for home products, a device setup or task for gadgets, a screen or workspace moment for digital products and services), in its problem state. Muted, slightly cooler tones. For weight, body-shape or health conditions, show the progression through lifestyle cues (energy, mood, routine, environment), never body or medical comparisons. Do not show the product inside the circle.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Center, circular photo about 25% of the canvas width in diameter, spanning about 30.5-55.5% of the canvas width and 33.5-58.5% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows a first noticeable, believable improvement
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Exactly the same subject, crop, angle and lighting setup as circle 1, scaled up, with a partial, realistic improvement. Neutral tones. Do not show the product inside the circle.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right, circular photo about 32% of the canvas width in diameter, spanning about 59-91% of the canvas width and 30-62% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the desired end result and closes the story; the visual destination of the sequence
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Same subject, crop and lighting as circles 1 and 2, scaled up again, now in the desired result state: warmest, most vibrant tones. Ring it with a brand-accent outline (about 1% of the canvas width) and a faint accent glow. Keep the change realistic and natural, never exaggerated. Do not show the product inside the circle.

detected_visual_blocks.position: One rounded pill straddling the top edge of each circle, centered horizontally on it (about 36%, 33.5% and 30% of the canvas height)
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Dates each stage so the sequence reads as time passing
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small rounded pills of equal height (about 4.5% of the canvas height). Pills 1 and 2 in a muted palette tone; pill 3 filled with the brand accent. Each carries a short time stamp that is realistic for the product.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Centered under each circle on one shared baseline, from about 65% to 71% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Names what is happening at each stage in a few words
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One short caption per circle describing that stage of the progression for the user's product; all three on the same baseline regardless of circle size.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom center, from about 74% to 95% of the canvas height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Connects the whole progression to what is being sold
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, packaging, label and colors), front or 3/4 view, standing on an implied surface with a soft contact shadow, about 20-22% of the canvas height. For digital products or services, show the attached image as it appears (e.g. on a small phone or as its cover) at the same size.

text_layers.reference_position: Top center, first element of the canvas
text_layers.text_style: Extra bold sans-serif, large (each line about 6.5-7.5% of the canvas height), max 2 lines, centered, maximum contrast against the background; the time expression may use the brand accent color
text_layers.guia_texto: La promesa de progreso en el tiempo según el ángulo, en 4 a 8 palabras (ej. la idea de 'lo que cambia en 30 días'). Debe invitar a recorrer la secuencia.

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the pill on the top edge of circle 1
text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, about 2.8-3% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered inside the rounded pill; light text on a muted palette tone
text_layers.guia_texto: Marca de tiempo de la etapa inicial, 1 a 2 palabras (ej. 'Día 1').

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the pill on the top edge of circle 2
text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, about 2.8-3% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered inside the rounded pill; same style as stage label 1
text_layers.guia_texto: Marca de tiempo intermedia, 1 a 2 palabras (ej. 'Día 7' o 'Semana 2'). Usa plazos creíbles para el producto.

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the pill on the top edge of circle 3
text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, about 3-3.2% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered inside a rounded pill filled with the brand accent color, high-contrast text
text_layers.guia_texto: Marca de tiempo final, 1 a 2 palabras (ej. 'Día 30'). Debe ser un plazo realista para el resultado.

text_layers.reference_position: Centered under circle 1, on the shared caption baseline
text_layers.text_style: Medium weight sans-serif, about 2.6-3% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered, high contrast
text_layers.guia_texto: El punto de partida o el dolor de la etapa 1, en 2 a 3 palabras.

text_layers.reference_position: Centered under circle 2, on the shared caption baseline
text_layers.text_style: Medium weight sans-serif, about 2.6-3% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered, high contrast
text_layers.guia_texto: El primer cambio que se nota, en 2 a 3 palabras.

text_layers.reference_position: Centered under circle 3, on the shared caption baseline
text_layers.text_style: Semi-bold sans-serif, about 2.8-3.2% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered; may use the brand accent color to mark the result
text_layers.guia_texto: El resultado deseado de la etapa final, en 2 a 4 palabras, sin promesas exageradas.

mandatory_visual_elements: Three circular photo frames growing in size from left to right (about 20%, 25% and 32% of the canvas width)
The same subject, crop and lighting in all three circles with a visible, believable progression from cool and muted to warm and vibrant
Thin horizontal timeline track through the circle centers with a chevron arrow in each gap
Brand-accent ring and faint glow on the largest (result) circle
Rounded time-label pill on the top edge of each circle
The user's product centered in the bottom band with a soft contact shadow
forbidden_additions: A fourth stage or extra circles
Rectangular photo panels or a two-panel before/after split
Number badges (1, 2, 3) instead of time labels
Charts, graphs, percentages or numeric data overlays
The product repeated inside the circles
Body, weight or medical before/after comparisons
notas_paleta: Paleta de marca completa en el fondo y los elementos gráficos: el fondo usa el color principal (liso o en degradado suave), la línea de tiempo pasa de un tono apagado al color de acento, y la píldora final, el aro y el brillo del círculo 3 usan el acento. Las fotos dentro de los círculos mantienen tonos naturales, de más fríos y apagados en la etapa 1 a más cálidos y vivos en la etapa 3.
